limits: All main theorems remain unverified.

The actual H^-1 spectral periods now satisfy uniform complex-neighborhood quartic-gap, gap/Arnold-period and quadratic weighted cubic-period estimates, including collapsed gaps. These are potential-space statements for the constructed source-normalized periods; global Birkhoff action identification and analytic action-space descent remain required.

Global potential-space gluing is now proved: one complex-open neighborhood of the entire real H^-1 space carries all canonical polynomial and cubic moments, agrees with every actual real period, and retains locally uniform complex-tail quadratic bounds. Finite-gap exterior matching, the normalized inversion remainder of Lemma 4.4 and the physical energy/frequency identities remain open.

Construct the full Cartesian KdV spectral coordinates and an analytic inverse potential realization near all real normalized Hilbert pairs. Prove their quadratic actions equal the actual Arnold actions and that equal action sequences determine the full discriminant, then instantiate the verified positive-ell2 analytic contour extension. The actual normalized Dirichlet energy and logarithmic norming sequences extend jointly as Banach analytic ell2 maps near every real H^-1 potential. Their full bounded Jacobian is now analytic on the same domain and has exact intrinsic energy and corrected sine-cosine norming functional coordinates at every real potential, including all closed gaps and arbitrary complex directions. Its mean-zero restriction at zero is an explicit Fourier isomorphism and gives a two-sided local analytic inverse. Prove mean-zero Jacobian invertibility at every real potential and the required global inverse and symplectic/action identities. The closed/self-adjoint Hill operator domain and periodic multiplicity identification, physical renormalized Hamiltonian/frequencies, -6*Id and main Theorems 1.1-1.3 remain unverified.

Every actual canonical cubic period is real and nonpositive, strictly negative exactly on an open gap. Even polynomial Arnold periods are nonnegative; the level-zero Arnold and cubic zero sets equal the closed-gap set. These signs and zero criteria hold for the common all-index family and its matched source tail at every real input. Global Birkhoff actions have not yet been identified with the Arnold periods.

The energy-analytic endpoint unit root is controlled uniformly over nearby complex H^-1 inputs. Joint potential analyticity of that chosen deflated root and a single neighborhood for all error tolerances are not asserted.
Physical energy and frequency identification, the KdV quadratic coefficients giving -6*Id, positive-index Hessian transport and main Theorems 1.2 and 1.3 remain unproved.
No full repository build or replacement of the dissertation validation is claimed.

The actual global canonical periods are proved invariant under equality of the entire real discriminant, including central and closed gaps. The coordinate-extension theorem now composes these actual functions with any spectral coordinate realization and derives common-neighborhood weighted action descent, absolute positive-ell2 summation, nonpositivity and zero at zero. Construction of that coordinate realization and the physical energy/frequency identity remain essential unproved inputs.

The actual H^-1 discriminant is now identified with the trace of unique absolutely continuous representative-based rough quasi-derivative IVPs in every analytic shifted-Miura chart, at all complex energies including zero. The physical profile has the literal unit-period Fourier coefficients and the exact constant energy shift. This does not yet construct a chart-independent singular Hill operator domain or prove its self-adjoint spectral realization.

Every actual canonical real characteristic label now has a nonzero scalar H1 weak solution of the chart Miura form with exact indexed periodic/antiperiodic endpoint sign. Full weak Green identities and all complex multiplier criteria are proved. The intrinsic weak form is now chart independent below. The intrinsic weak-solution converse is now proved. The closed operator domain, self-adjointness and spectral multiplicity identification remain unproved.

The intrinsic weak Hill form is now independent of Miura chart for every AC/L2-derivative curve pair with periodic product endpoints. It is entire in complex H^-1 and its potential term is bounded complex linear in q. The intrinsic weak eigenfunction predicate has no chart in its statement, and actual characteristic multipliers and canonical real labels give such nonzero H1 scalar functions. The weak-solution converse is now proved. The closed/self-adjoint operator domain and multiplicity identification remain separate.

The full contour family and termwise derivative theorem use the proved analytic-base-moment/tail-bound interface. They do not construct the actual KdV Birkhoff realization or identify the physical Hamiltonian and frequencies; all main theorem flags remain false.

Actual Dirichlet zeros at every real H^-1 input are now exactly the unique positive-gap labels, are real and have analytic order one. Intrinsic weak Dirichlet energy and eigenspace identification is proved. The full closed/self-adjoint operator domain and periodic algebraic multiplicities remain open.

The normalized Dirichlet energies and actual logarithmic norming sequence now both extend as Banach analytic ell2 maps near the entire real H^-1 space. Full Cartesian KdV inverse coordinates and symplectic/action identities remain open.

The normalized scalar Dirichlet curve is intrinsic and jointly entire with values in the continuous-curve uniform norm. At the actual positive-gap labels the endpoint factors and logarithmic norming data are intrinsic and locally analytic in original H^-1. Their common sequence-valued analytic neighborhood, tail estimates, global inverse and symplectic/action identities remain open. All main theorem flags remain false.

The high Arnold action has a uniform complex-neighborhood upper bound C*gap^2/n, complementing the proved reverse bound. These are estimates for actual source-normalized spectral periods, not an identification with quadratic KdV Birkhoff actions. All main theorem flags remain false.

All actual Arnold actions now form a single complex Banach-analytic weighted ell1 map near all real H^-1 potentials. The majorant is an actual locally bounded diagonal NLS ell2 gap sequence. A full Cartesian coordinate map and inverse realization, the converse action-fiber/discriminant identity and the physical positive-ell2 Hamiltonian extension remain open. No injectivity or analytic inverse of the action map itself is asserted.

The normalized Dirichlet coordinate E_n=(mu_n-pi^2*n^2)/(1+n) is now one global complex Banach-analytic ell2 map near the entire real H^-1 space. Every recovered scalar branch is an actual complex Dirichlet zero on this domain. Exhaustion of all roots at nonreal potentials and a global analytic norming sequence are not asserted; full Cartesian inverse/symplectic identities and all main theorems remain open.

The global logarithmic norming sequence K_n=log((-1)^n Re(gamma_n)) is now one complex Banach analytic ell2 map near the entire real H^-1 space. Exact Miura terminal-factor comparison and signed anti-discriminant samples fix every index; inverse-sinh superposition handles the sequence norm. This is not yet the Cartesian KdV inverse realization, and the positive-ell2 extension and all main theorems remain open.

The actual normalized Dirichlet scalar column is now jointly entire in the full continuous/L2 H1 graph. Every actual complex root branch has the exact H^-1 differential da[h]*integral Y^2=<h,Y^2>, and the global Hilbert normalized energy map has the corresponding derivative with factor 1+n. Explicit free Fourier linearization, the Cartesian inverse and symplectic/action identities are not yet proved; Theorems 1.1-1.3 remain open.

The exact free Dirichlet column is sin(n*pi*x)/(n*pi); its squared mass and H^-1 potential pairing now fix the actual derivative dmu_n(0)[h]=h_0-(h_n+h_-n)/2. The global normalized ell2 energy map has this full bounded derivative divided by 1+n. The logarithmic norming derivative, combined mean-zero inverse and all main theorems remain unproved.

The combined actual energy/norming map now has a two-sided complex analytic inverse on open neighborhoods of zero in mean-zero H^-1 and ell2 x ell2. A global Cartesian KdV inverse near all real normalized Hilbert pairs, symplecticity, Arnold action identities and the unconditional main theorems remain open.

The entire bounded Hilbert spectral Jacobian is now analytic on the actual global potential domain, with exact energy and chart-independent norming functionals at every real potential. Invertibility of its mean-zero restriction away from zero, global Cartesian KdV coordinates, symplectic/action identities and the unconditional main theorems remain open.
